Hi Evelyn,

We're nearing the end of our 30-day trial and running out of credits. The engineering team has made good progress integrating Redwood Inference into our streaming pipeline, but we need another couple of weeks to finish end-to-end perf tests and validate latency under realistic loads.

A bit of context — StormByte is evaluating Redwood for our core feature which would be a paid deployment if perf checks out (we're projecting ~$120k ARR potential in year one across our product). We're on a tight internal timeline, so a 14-day grace window would be ideal.

Appreciate any help you can offer.

Thanks,

Hi Olly —

Thanks for the context and the POC plan — this is exactly the kind of evaluation we want to support. A couple quick clarifying questions before I escalate for an exception:

- Do you expect the 5,000 credits to be consumed primarily by short per-request latency tests (many small calls) or longer end-to-end runs (fewer, longer sessions)?
- Do you have a rough estimate of peak qps during the next two weeks?

Our standard self-serve trial top-up is up to 1,000 credits for 7 days. Anything above that (like the 5,000 you requested) requires manager approval because it exceeds the automated threshold. If you can confirm the usage profile I will request the manager sign-off and, if approved, issue the top-up as a one-time credit with a 30-day expiration.

If immediate runway would unblock your demo this week and you only need a short bridge, we can also do a 7-day 1,000-credit self-serve top-up right away while I get approval for the larger request.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, PLG Sales
Redwood Inference
